scope: Export appearance and existing CAD save workflow. Public demo drawings verify white-background contrast, original RGB mode, model-space widths, lineweights, persisted preferences, source protection, and DWG/DXF round trips. No private customer drawings are included. Appearance in a mobile CAD app has not been tested.

checks: Changing the viewport zoom does not change the CAD label height
DXF label heights match model dimensions and omit optional camera metadata by default
DXF keeps exact RGB colors on cameras, sectors, cables and flags
DXF export contains the base, editable cable vertices, length flags, camera and Polish labels
Exported DXF reopens as ordinary CAD geometry without its local overlay
CAD text height persists when the source drawing is reopened
DWG retains exact RGB colors after conversion and independent WASM parsing
A real AutoCAD 2018 DWG reopens through the independent LibreDWG WASM reader
The Cmd+S menu action writes camera and cable geometry into a DWG that opens without the local project
Overlay-only export keeps the original drawing coordinates and excludes the base geometry
File save finishes and embeds a pending cable route together with the base
Explicit text height and optional camera parameters are embedded in CAD
Saving a file resets the full-drawing option after an installation-only export
Cancelling the native save dialog leaves the project open and unchanged
Choosing the source file as the export destination is rejected without modifying it
Readable-color DXF retains route widths and explicit lineweights with fine camera sectors
Export appearance leaves editable project colors and geometry unchanged
Color mode, stroke weight and model width persist after reopening
DWG conversion round trip retains contrast, lineweights and nonzero polyline widths
No renderer errors during the complete export workflow
